history.summary: Large 999-year leasehold 4BR (1,528 sqft) in a 696-unit Bukit Panjang development with a covered walkway straight to Cashew MRT (DT2, ~280m). Excellent transit and quasi-freehold tenure, but $2.7M at $1,767 PSF is at the top of the recent transacted range and a 4BR in D23 is a thin buyer band.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified recent Hazel Park txns run ~$1,546-$1,804 PSF, so $1,767 is near the top — not a value entry. The 999-yr lease, 696-unit scale and 280m covered link to Cashew DT2 are strong, and the score_1000 of 395 is depressed only by missing URA data, not real weakness. But $2.7M for a 4BR in OCR Bukit Panjang has a shallow buyer pool and a soft exit.
red_flags: $1,767 PSF at the top of recent transacted range — little value cushion
$2.7M 4BR in D23 is a thin, niche buyer pool
No URA appreciation data in dossier (verified externally instead)
catalysts: Large 696-unit development supports liquidity within its segment
